description: Ablation study: each variant removes one MechaAudit pipeline stage while keeping everything else fixed.

ablations.description: Replace semantic retrieval with random sampling of K=15 reports from the 394-report pool.
ablations.note: Removes retrieval ranking/filtering. Same SMT and harm verdict stages.

ablations.description: Remove solver-backed mechanism witness. Retrieval top-15 pairs passed directly to harm verdict LLM.
ablations.note: Remove solver-backed mechanism witness. Retrieval top-15 pairs passed directly to harm verdict LLM. Distinct from the 'Direct LLM' baseline in results/baselines/comparison_table.json, which additionally removes retrieval and applies the LLM directly to the whole contract without any retrieved report hypothesis.

ablations.description: Remove the Harm Verdict (E4c) stage. A contract is predicted positive if any function has at least one SMT-admitted (theorem-satisfying) mechanism unit, without running the Severity/Necessity/Feasibility harm-verdict chain.
ablations.note: SMT admission alone proves mechanism existence but not business harm; recall rises from 0.9000 to 0.9714 but FPR quadruples from 0.1293 to 0.5238, showing the harm verdict is indispensable for rejecting structurally-admitted-but-benign contracts.
